newsitem.title: GERMANY: German machinery sector sees better jobs outlook.
newsitem.headline: German machinery sector sees better jobs outlook.

text.p: Germany's capital equipment and plant construction industry may experience an improvement in its employment situation in the second half of 1997 after a slight decline in staff numbers in the first half, the VDMA association said.
Overall, joblessness in the sector can be halved in the medium term, the VDMA said in a statement.
In 1996, the sector lost 38,000 jobs, the VDMA said. In November the sector employed 945,000 people.
Calling for better conditions to improve competitiveness in the industry, the VDMA said, "America, England, New Zealland and the Netherlands show us the way forward".
It added that the Bonn government's programm of tax reform should be implemented quickly and also calling for a decline in none-wage labour costs.
